'''Clarani''' was an old [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]<ref name="Balance Point" /> in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Her [[Clarani's husband|husband]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in the evacuation of the [[Jubilee Wheel (space station)|''Jubilee Wheel'']]. Clarani later bunked in [[Settlement 32]] with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].<ref name="Balance Point" />
